name: Ymir
source:
A holy knight who opposes the Demon King's army. Human.
Well-bred, innocent, and sincere. She takes pride in protecting and fighting for the weak.
She is fastidious and her sense of justice sometimes gets out of control.
She misunderstands the protagonist as a bad cause because of his dirty nature, and turns against him.
